findings.location: paragraph 11 ("Ten langen leste, toen de bomen gelijkmatiger...)")
findings.source_quote: At length, as the trees subdued and thinned, and the meadow appeared Jamin knew this was the end of his brother’s trap route.
findings.suggested_fix: Use wording that more directly reflects 'subdued and thinned' (sense of trees becoming less dense and quieter). Suggested phrasing: "Ten langen leste, toen de bomen minder dicht en dunner werden, en de wei verscheen..." Preserve original HTML structure and punctuation.
findings.translation_quote: Ten langen leste, toen de bomen gelijkmatiger werden en dunner, en de wei verscheen, wist Jamin dat dit het einde van Kennys valroute was.

findings.location: paragraph 14 ("Snel wreven Jamins sterke armen de kaken open.")
findings.source_quote: Quickly, Jamin’s strong arms pried open the jaws.
findings.suggested_fix: 'Pried open' implies forcing the jaws apart; 'wreven' ('rubbed') is imprecise. Suggested phrasing: "Snel zetten Jamins sterke armen zich in en wrikten de kaken open." or "Snel wrikten Jamins sterke armen de kaken open." Preserve original HTML structure and punctuation.
findings.translation_quote: Snel wreven Jamins sterke armen de kaken open.
